scripts.ci:quality: npm run check:dependencies && npm run check:environments && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:integration && npm run lint && npm run test:all && npm run build:worker
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:worker && npm run deploy:worker:staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build:worker && npm run deploy:worker:production
scripts.deploy:staging:with-migrations: npm run db:migrate:staging && npm run deploy:staging
scripts.deploy:production:with-migrations: npm run db:migrate:production && npm run deploy:production
scripts.upload:staging: npm run build:worker && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs upload staging
scripts.upload:production: npm run build:worker && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs upload production
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env staging --remote
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --env production --remote

CF_TOKEN.description: Runtime Cloudflare API token used by CC Mail onboarding and domain-health checks. Cloudflare's deploy/build token is not passed to the app, so create this separately at https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens with `Zone Read`, `DNS Read`, `Email Routing Edit`, `Email Sending Edit`, and `Email Routing Rules Write` permissions for the zones you will connect. Paste only the token secret value, without `Bearer`.

CF_AID.description: Cloudflare account ID retained for compatibility with existing deployments.

D1_DATABASE_ID.description: Cloudflare D1 database ID retained for compatibility with existing deployments. Backups use the DB binding directly.

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key used to verify login and first-run registration challenges. Pair with NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY at build time.

MFA_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Required 32-byte base64url key used only to encrypt administrator TOTP secrets at rest. Generate a different value for every environment and store it as a Worker secret.

NEXT_PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY.description: Cloudflare Turnstile public site key used by the login and first-run registration widgets.

CF_EMAIL_WORKER_NAME.description: Worker name used when creating Cloudflare Email Routing rules. Set this to the deployed Worker name; if you rename the Worker, update this value too.

CF_EMAIL.description: Legacy Global API Key auth only. Use this with `CF_API_KEY` instead of `CF_TOKEN`.

CF_API_KEY.description: Legacy Global API Key auth only. Prefer `CF_TOKEN` for new deployments.
